principles.statement: Every factual assertion, including a question presupposition and a follow-up description, must be supported by supplied Evidence. An existing evidence ID alone does not establish entailment. Preserve original speech, uncertainty, conditions, negation, technical identifiers and source language.

Possibilities, proposals, requests, accepted commitments, refusals, completed historical work, and decisions are different states. An explicitly conditional candidate can be retained as a proposal; it is not accepted work. Do not require empty arrays merely to avoid false commitments.

Who spoke and who owns the work are separate. A mentioned person, same display name, role/title, or tentative request does not establish ownership. A reliably identified self-commitment or evidenced accepted assignment can establish an owner proposal. Ambiguous speakers/owners require explicit uncertainty and targeted clarification.

Respect explicit corrections and withdrawal of prior commitments. Keep earlier material distinguishable as historical/superseded; do not present it as current. A recent unaccepted proposal does not override an older valid decision merely through recency.

Confirmed decisions require supporting authority/context or accepted team agreement. A proposal, preference, open question, rejected option, or earlier decision is not automatically a new adopted decision. Reversing a group decision does not by itself identify personal objectors. Supporting and objecting participants need Evidence.

Capture all material accepted work, decisions, and unresolved questions without duplication, merging different owners, or reopening a question explicitly resolved in the supplied source. Do not demand exhaustive filler items or boilerplate risks.

Keep deadline meaning and uncertainty, distinguishing desired, rejected, conditional and accepted dates. Use the supplied workspace timezone and source instant for relative dates. The repository contract supplies Europe/Berlin; do not use the reviewer machine timezone.

All output here is a structured proposal before deterministic reconciliation. A proposed create-work-item is not evidence of an unauthorized provider write. Actual new work requires reconciliation and confirmed or intentionally unassigned ownership; explicit authorized safe write intent may suffice without redundant approval. This component does not execute anything.

Linear is canonical work; Notion is canonical knowledge and durable meeting destinations; GitHub supplies implementation Evidence. Search/reconcile before actual create. Candidate answers lack a Work Catalog, organizational retrieval results, permission state and execution receipts; do not penalize them for not performing unavailable tool operations.

Retrieval must respect current access and destination audience, bounded relevance, Human Judgment, current versus historical status and source revisions. These cases supply no additional organizational context. Assess extraction fidelity; record missing retrieval/recall coverage as a benchmark limitation rather than inventing undisclosed context facts.

Human Judgment outranks AI inference. AI review is provisional and cannot establish consent, source permissions, production readiness, a genuinely unseen holdout, or human ground truth. The full product requires end-to-end validation beyond this proposal schema.

Ask targeted questions only when an uncertainty actually remains and matters. Do not create repetitive clarification about already settled ownership, dates, causes or decisions. Unknown ownership must not become a guessed or falsely certain assignee.

limitations: This is a root-authored synthesis of selected product requirements, not independently authored human gold labels. Raw Notion snapshots stay private in the ignored work directory.
Notion is product context for review, not extra meeting Evidence. Do not import actual founder roles or real project facts into fictional scenarios.
The evaluated component uses the provider-comparison-v1 prompt/schema with an empty additional-context list. Later merged production capabilities are outside this historical evaluation.
Source pages contain dated implementation snapshots. This brief uses semantic product rules and makes no current deployment/completion claims.

Repository CONTEXT.md and ADRs 0002/0006/0007 corroborate Evidence, proposal/reconciliation separation, and speaker versus ownership rules. The original output schema cannot represent every newer domain state. Report representation gaps separately.
